description: Mirror of the canonical cross-pool drain: swap 10000 on A (collect 99, earn 49) and 10000 on B (collect 99, earn 49), then claim 49 on pool B three times. The seeded hook checks each request against lifetime entitlement (49) instead of remaining entitlement, so all three succeed and pay 147 total on B: 147 > 49 earned demonstrates R2, and 147 > 99 collected on B demonstrates R3 because the third payment is backed by pool A's reserve (custody 198 -> 51, below A's 99). The repaired control pays 49 once and rejects the two repeats with no violation.
